task.title: Make package audit discover skill assets from pi.skills
task.summary: Patch the package audit to inspect package-declared Pi skill assets instead of requiring CodeWiki-specific skills/codewiki paths.

goal.outcome: Package audit is package-neutral for Pi skills and no longer emits CodeWiki skill false positives against packages such as ThinkCode.
acceptance: auditPackage reads package.json pi.skills entries and discovers actual skill assets under those entries.
Package audit no longer hardcodes skills/codewiki/** as required package artifacts.
Discovered real skill assets are required to exist and to appear in npm pack --dry-run output.
A smoke test covers a non-CodeWiki skill package with skills/think-code/SKILL.md.
non_goals: Redesign all package manifest checks unrelated to skill assets.

closure_brief.user_intent: Fix CodeWiki package audit false positives when auditing ThinkCode by deriving skill requirements from package.json pi.skills rather than skills/codewiki hardcodes.
implemented_changes: Package audit discovers skill asset files from pi.skills entries and requires those actual assets in reachability, npm pack dry-run, and fingerprints.
Removed audit.ts hardcoded skills/codewiki package asset requirements.
Added ThinkCode-style smoke coverage for non-CodeWiki skill packages and omitted packed skill assets.
acceptance_evidence: Fresh DefaultResourceLoader execution of codewiki_audit package on /home/nunoc/projects/think-code passed with 0 issues.
non_goals_preserved: Did not redesign unrelated package manifest checks.
remaining_risks: Current Pi session must reload to replace stale injected codewiki_audit implementation.

risks: Package audit still retains existing broader CodeWiki package checks for src/index.ts, scripts/check-architecture.mjs, and core files; TASK-016 intentionally scoped the fix to package-neutral Pi skill assets.
